tasks.answer: Export name: TravelerBookingDetailScreen (named export). Import path: @/features/traveler-bookings/booking-detail-screen. Required props: bookId (string). Props type: { bookId: string }. Constraint: bookId is required; actions are permission-gated and the screen needs query and router providers. Note: the catalog describes this as the traveler booking detail screen (status transitions, evaluations, media); no separate entry named for 'special passenger' (特殊旅客) exists, so this is the only booking-detail screen available.

Export name: UiPopup (named export). Import path: @/components/ui/overlay. Required props: onClose. Constraint: onClose is required; open defaults to false; position defaults to bottom and safeArea to false. Alternative: FilterSheet from @/components/business/mobile (required props visible, title, children, onClose) if a filter-specific bottom sheet is wanted.

Login page: export name SignInPage, import path @/features/auth/sign-in-page (staff sign-in with password and SMS tabs, captcha and redirect handling; no required props, redirect is optional). Top navigation bar: export name UiNavBar, import path @/components/ui/navigation (no required props; back uses router history unless onBack/onClickLeft is supplied; fixed enables the fixed layout).

Export name: FlightDelayCompensationListScreen (named export). Import path: @/features/flight-delay-compensation/list-screen. Required props: context and onContextChange. Constraint: context and onContextChange are required; queries are enabled only when the user holds the query permission.

Missing: the catalog has no image viewer / image preview component.
